title: [main]- Negative Shipped and Invoiced Quantities appear on Sales Order Lines after using the Copy Document from a Sales Credit Memo.
summary: When a sales credit memo created with Copy Document from a posted invoice that has the same item on several lines is posted, each credit memo line now resolves to a different invoice line. This stops negative Quantity Shipped and Quantity Invoiced on one sales order line while another order line stays unchanged.
key_points: Added an overload to GetSalesInvoiceLine that tracks already-consumed invoice lines to avoid duplicate matching
Introduced FindUnusedSalesInvoiceLine helper method to skip previously matched invoice lines
UpdateSalesOrderLineIfExist maintains a temporary buffer of resolved invoice lines to prevent reuse across multiple credit memo lines
Fixes issue where all credit memo lines matched the first invoice line when copying from invoices with duplicate items
quote: Copy Document does not populate Appl.-from Item Entry on the credit memo lines
